SYED AHMAD NABI

Project Manager | Delivery Manager — Banking, Digital Transformation & FinTech

Bengaluru, India | +91  9916587224 

 | syedahmadnabi9@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/syedahmadnabi

PMP® (Project Management Professional) | CSM® (Certified Scrum Master)

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Project, Program, and Delivery Manager with 20+ years leading banking, digital transformation, and FinTech programmes across the Middle East and India. Proven leader of cross-functional teams and executive stakeholders, combining Agile/hybrid delivery, PMO governance, and risk and change management to consistently deliver measurable business outcomes with 100% regulatory compliance.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Program & Delivery Leadership: Project, Program & Delivery Management, PMO Governance, Agile & Hybrid Delivery, SDLC

Executive & Stakeholder Management: Steering committees, executive reporting, cross-functional leadership, conflict resolution, vendor management

Risk, Governance & Compliance: RAID & risk management, regulatory compliance, audit management, business continuity

Change & Transformation: Change management, resource planning, process improvement, benefits realisation

Banking Delivery: Core banking (Finacle), system & data migration, UAT planning & execution

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Project Manager – Banking Transformation & Digital Delivery

Emirates NBD Group, Dubai, UAE | Sep 2012 – Apr 2026

Own end-to-end delivery of banking and digital transformation programmes — chairing steering committees, managing executive stakeholders, and directing cross-functional teams of 15+ across IT, Risk, Compliance, and Operations.

Finacle Core Banking Migration — Mediated a conflict between IT's aggressive cutover date and Risk/Compliance's control requirements by chairing the steering committee and building a phased rollback plan. Delivered on schedule with 100% data integrity and zero downtime.

Genesys Cloud Migration — Resolved conflicting IVR requirements between operations, IT, and the vendor through structured stakeholder workshops and direct vendor negotiation. Cut handling time by 15%, improved routing accuracy, and earned Top Contributor recognition (Sep 2025).

Digital Collections Transformation — Led change management for a resistant, long-tenured team while redesigning and automating the collections workflow with IT. Achieved 90%+ user adoption, a 30% efficiency gain, and 40% less manual effort.

Ebix DCore Implementation — Resolved recurring audit-versus-delivery friction by setting up a joint governance forum and personally owning remediation tracking. Cut audit issues by 20% while preserving the delivery timeline.

Project Coordinator – UAT & Data Migration Programmes

Dubai Bank (merged with Emirates Islamic Bank), UAE | Jan 2009 – Sep 2012

Dubai Bank–Emirates Islamic Bank Integration — Led post-merger integration across IT, Operations, and Compliance for 50,000+ live customer accounts, resolving scope and cutover disagreements before they escalated. Delivered zero customer-impacting incidents.

UAT & Data Migration Programmes — Designed and executed 200+ UAT test cases, prioritising the highest-risk areas with Compliance under a tight programme timeline. Achieved 100% compliance sign-off and a 15% efficiency gain.

Credit Analyst / Senior Collections Officer

Citibank, Dubai, UAE | Oct 2005 – Nov 2008

Led and coached a 10+ member collections team managing an AED 50M+ high-risk portfolio, personally handling sensitive escalations and client negotiations. Reduced credit losses by 15% and exceeded recovery targets by 20%.

KEY PROJECTS

Project Scope & Role Business Impact Finacle Core Banking Migration Multi-entity migration; steering committee chair 100% data integrity, zero downtime Emirates NBD X Mobile Banking Transformation Enterprise mobile banking transformation Seamless go-live, improved customer experience Mobile Tablet Digitisation Programme Paperless workflow transformation Faster turnaround, improved efficiency Genesys Cloud Migration IVR & contact-centre migration 15% faster handling, Top Contributor award Digital Collections Transformation Process redesign & change management 30% efficiency gain, 90%+ adoption Ebix DCore Implementation Governance & audit remediation 20% fewer audit issues Dubai Bank–Emirates Islamic Bank Integration Post-merger integration, 50,000+ accounts Zero customer-impacting incidents UAT & Data Migration Programmes 200+ UAT test cases executed 100% compliance sign-off

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS

Top Contributor award for the Genesys Cloud go-live at Emirates NBD, September 2025.

Led 4+ transformation programmes with zero customer-impacting incidents across 15+ years.

Delivered the Finacle core banking migration with 100% data integrity and full audit compliance.

Reduced audit findings by 20% through proactive governance and remediation ownership.

Achieved 90%+ user adoption on major change initiatives through structured change management.

20+ years of unblemished regulatory compliance across banking transformation programmes.

TECHNOLOGY ENVIRONMENT

Jira, Confluence, MS Project, SharePoint, Smartsheet, Monday.com, Power BI, Finacle, Genesys Cloud, Microsoft Teams

CERTIFICATIONS

Project Management Professional (PMP®) – PMI, USA | Cert. No. 4181418

Certified Scrum Master (CSM®) – Scrum Alliance, USA | Cert. No. 0011790889

EDUCATION

MBA (Marketing) – Manipal Academy of Higher Education, Dubai Campus | 2008

LANGUAGES

English (Fluent) | Hindi/Urdu (Native)
